name: Eliphaz
overview: Eliphaz is identified in Scripture as a son of Esau through his wife Adah, establishing his place within the lineage of Edom (Genesis 36:4, 10). He fathered several sons, including Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz, and had a concubine named Timna who bore Amalek, highlighting his role as a patriarch in the Edomite family line (Genesis 36:11-12). Additionally, Eliphaz is known as a friend of Job, connecting him to the narrative of suffering and divine sovereignty in the book of Job.
